mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the balance routes to the body was most worthwhile: seeing the eyes move opposite the head made the purpose of the sensors clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the nerve routes separately at the end felt repetitive because the body already showed the connected response.

surprise.text: The weighted sensors respond to changes in straight-line movement as well as tilt; I had mainly expected them to sense tilt.

arbitrary.text: The final separate nerve-route combination felt unclear as a requirement after the assembled sensors had already been connected through the brain to the body.

continue.text: Yes, I would try another chapter: seeing how the inner ear helps keep the eyes steady made me curious about other connections between body systems.
